data.name: Trash Bandits
data.detailed_description:
Dumpster diving has evolved.

Trash Bandits is a chaotic co-op adventure for up to 4 players where you and your raccoon crew sneak through neighborhoods, break into houses, steal valuables, and escape before the humans catch on. Pull off messy heists, haul your loot back to safety, and build the ultimate raccoon stash in your hidden hideout.

Work together to carry loot, distract homeowners, scout targets, and make your escape. Every run is unpredictable — one bad move can turn a quiet robbery into a frantic chase through backyards, streets, and alleyways.

Between heists, return to your hideout to organize your stash, show off your best finds, and prepare for the next job. Whether you’re carefully planning the perfect robbery or barely escaping with stolen junk and your dignity intact, Trash Bandits is built around cooperative chaos, funny moments, and raccoon-powered crime.

Features

  • Online co-op gameplay for up to 4 players

  • Sneak through neighborhoods and rob houses

  • Escape with valuable loot before getting caught

  • Organize your own raccoon hideout

  • Craft Gear

  • Physics-driven chaos and unpredictable situations

  • Work together to distract, carry, and escape

  • Stylized low-poly visuals

  • Dynamic objectives and replayable missions

In Trash Bandits, the neighborhood is your playground — and nothing is safe from a determined raccoon.
